question: What does the idiom 'Cry wolf' mean?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Raise a false alarm**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Cry wolf"** means to give a false alarm or to raise a warning about something that is not true. (झूठी चेतावनी देना)

 
 
• **Example:** If you cry wolf too many times, people will stop believing you even when you're telling the truth.
 
 
 
• **"Raise a false alarm"** refers to warning others about danger or an issue that does not exist or is fabricated. (झूठी चेतावनी देना)
 
 
• **Example:** The student raised a false alarm about a fire in the school to avoid the exam.
 
 
 
• Hence, the idiom **"Cry wolf"** means **"Raise a false alarm."**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Raise a false alarm**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: Be truthful **(सत्य बोलना): To always tell the truth and be honest.

 
 
• **Example:** It is important to be truthful in all your dealings.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: Lie unnecessarily **(बिना कारण झूठ बोलना): To tell lies without any valid reason.
 
 
• **Example:** He often lies unnecessarily, which makes it hard to trust him.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: Help others **(दूसरों की मदद करना): To assist or support someone in need.
 
 
• **Example:** We should always help others whenever we can.
 
 

8f:Tc33,
The correct answer is **Option 4**.
